checks.evidence: CNSC project page (modified 2026-01-15) still shows 'Current Status: Paused' and says CNSC staff paused the environmental assessment and application review as of August 2024. Separately, the World Nuclear Association country profile reports that CNL closed its invitation programme in July 2026 and that the Chalk River and Whiteshell proposals are no longer active within the CNL process. That is a different process from the CNSC licence, so the CNSC pause status stands.

applications.name: Last Energy PWR-5 pilot reactor at Texas A&M RELLIS
applications.timeline: Preliminary documented safety analysis approved, release dated 2026-05-28. On 2026-09-10 the company said: "In the next couple of months, we intend to get final authorization from the Department of Energy".
applications.what_it_says: Last Energy is building a PWR-5 pilot reactor on the Texas A&M RELLIS campus near Bryan-College Station. The company says the reactor is scaled for 5 MW of electrical output. The pilot is a DOE-authorized test unit, and the company says it is not meant to power homes or businesses right away. The RELLIS site record still reads pre-application, which covers the NRC early-site-permit track and not this DOE pilot.
applications.microreactor_read: A 5 MW electric pilot sits inside the 1-20 MW band, but it is a test unit under DOE authorization, not a commercial sale. No power buyer or price is named.
